variants.name: A-toolbar-dropdown
variants.detail: A — minimal extension of existing layout. Put a visible compact dropdown chip 近一个星期 with a small calendar icon beside the result heading, and the three-way view control on the right. Time dropdown is OPEN beneath its chip, a small elegant anchored popover listing 今天 / 近三天 / 近一个星期 (checked) / 近一个月 / 自定义日期; bottom separated action 设为默认时间. Keep result list full width. Do not cover the selected 按频次 tab. No bars on rows. Aim at lowest interaction cost and closest visual match to reference.
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity desktop UI design screenshot for History Sweep, a local browser history cleaner. Reference image 1 is the existing PUBLIC product screenshot using fictional example domains, use it only as visual style and layout reference. Output landscape 1536x1024, sharp readable Simplified Chinese text, flat straight-on actual application UI, no photography, no device mockup, no decorative presentation framing, no external annotations. Keep visual language: very light gray background, white rounded cards, charcoal text and black primary buttons, quiet gray lines, subtle shadows, compact clean Chinese typography. Preserve top-left History Sweep wordmark, search row (试试网站或关键词 / 智能匹配 / 搜索历史), top-right 本机处理 / EN 中文 / theme / settings. Preserve bottom selection/action bar 已选 0 项 with disabled 删除选中项 and small warning 删除一个 URL 会移除它的全部访问记录. Main result card has heading 8 条结果, 来自 3 个网站. Critical requirement: a three-way segmented control exactly 按日期 | 按网站 | 按频次, with 按频次 selected. Use exact visible timeframe label 近一个星期 (never 最近三天). All variants represent the same function, URL rows sorted by number of visits inside the selected time descending. Make the count label 期间访问次数 and supporting text 按所选时间内的访问次数排序. Fictional data only: 使用指南 / docs.example.org/guide / 28 次; 项目笔记 / example.org/notes / 16 次; 阅读清单 / news.example.com/reading / 9 次; 工具参考 / docs.example.org/tools / 7 次; 每周回顾 / example.org/weekly / 4 次; 设计资料 / example.org/design / 3 次; 产品更新 / news.example.com/updates / 2 次; 帮助中心 / docs.example.org/help / 1 次. Each row has a checkbox, title above gray URL, last access date, count. Do not show private real browsing or any extra feature such as AI analysis, accounts, cloud sync, heatmaps or charts. Distinct layout requirement follows:

Time dropdown is OPEN beneath its chip, a small elegant anchored popover listing 今天 / 近三天 / 近一个星期 (checked) / 近一个月 / 自定义日期; bottom separated action 设为默认时间. Keep result list full width. corrections: Edit target: this UI screenshot. Preserve the entire layout, sizing, UI controls, fictional URLs and descending visit counts exactly. Make only two corrections to the results table: replace the standalone 今天 label in the table header with 网页 (this is a frequency sorted list and must NOT have any date grouping); change the fictional last-access date years from 2024 to 2026, keeping month/day and row order. Exact segmented labels 按日期 / 按网站 / 按频次 (last selected). Exact timeframe label 近一个星期. All eight rows should span 2026年10月10日 to 2026年10月16日 inclusive, duplicate dates allowed. Keep dropdown open in same place. No new elements. Return only full screenshot.

Edit this exact screenshot. Make only TWO small Chinese text replacements at specified positions; everything else must stay pixel-consistent. At approximately x=200 y=350 in the 1536x1024 image, the table first column header currently reads 今天 immediately to the right of a checkbox: replace ONLY those two characters with 网页. At approximately x=158 y=274, below 8 条结果, the text currently reads 网页: replace ONLY that label with 来自 3 个网站. Do not change the 今天 option inside the OPEN dropdown at x=308 y=268; that dropdown option must remain 今天. Keep all dates, all rows, all counts, all controls and sizes exactly unchanged. Return the full edited screenshot.

variants.name: B-filter-popover
variants.detail: B — filter controls collected into the existing filter icon in search row. Keep a visible passive chip 近一个星期 beside 8 条结果. Show the top filter icon active and its OPEN anchored popover on the upper right below search row. Popover title 时间范围 with radio choices 今天 / 近三天 / 近一个星期 (selected) / 近一个月 / 自定义日期, then checkbox 设为默认时间, footer black button 应用. Keep 按频次 tab clearly visible. Compact count column has quiet neutral gray proportional bars behind the count numbers, as tiny row indicators, not a dashboard. No sidebar. Popover should cover at most upper two rows and never the segmented control.

variants.name: C-time-sidebar
variants.detail: C — persistent slim time sidebar inside the result card, 180px wide on the left, divided from results by one light vertical line. Sidebar title 时间范围, stacked navigation 今天 / 近三天 / 近一个星期 (selected) / 近一个月 / 自定义日期. A small bottom checkbox 设为默认时间. The result card top header and three-way segmented view control span entire width above sidebar. Right content has compact row list, small summary pill 近一个星期 and caption 按所选时间内的访问次数排序. All eight records remain legible. Preserve simple black and white tool aesthetic, no conventional dashboard site sidebar outside card.

variants.name: D-default-preferences
variants.detail: D — compact history layout with timeframe chip 近一个星期 above URL list and a small beside-it link 默认时间设置. Show a modest centered OPEN settings dialog 460px wide, with lightly dimmed surrounding app that still clearly shows three tabs and active 按频次, and several ranked rows. Dialog title 默认浏览时间. Description 打开时使用此时间范围. A clean select-like list with 今天 / 近三天 / 近一个星期 (checked) / 近一个月, plus footer buttons 取消 and black 保存. Tiny explanation 当前浏览范围可单独切换. Keep top brand and bottom selected-delete bar visible behind overlay. Dialog is the main focal point. No sidebar, no graphs. This variant demonstrates changing a persisted default separately from current timeframe.
